title: Read Only Memories Studio Files For Bankruptcy with $800k in debt - Should they have used AI to save more money?
author: sharkymcstevenson2

comments.body: Why did they go bankrupt? Are they stupid?

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: Have they tried making more money

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:

replies.author: Mindestiny
replies.body: Yep.  This is mismanagement of funds and labor, not a "boo hoo devs and artists cost too much to hire" issue.  Startup bullshit doesnt stop being startup bullshit just because it's a game studio.

replies.body:
I'm an actual game developer with 20 years of experience.  
   
I don't know where to even start explaining to you how many issues there are with your question. Especially that 99% number is bonkers.

comments.author: pineappleoptics
comments.body: How exactly? They only had a few employees to begin with. AI isn't free, nor is it's implementation into existing pipelines.

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: The main reason the game failed has nothing to do with AI. This is a common mistake among many Western studios, they have no FUCKING CLUE what their audience wants. If you are gonna pay homage to Japanese games from the 90s like Snatcher and Policenatus, BE FAITHFUL to the original source; do not use ugly "modern" Westernized anime, or inject your modern politics into the game. All these kinds of games, like those repulsive "dating sims" with Tumblr designs, are dead on arrival. Using AI will only make the studio fail later.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Sure, but they could have avoided going $800k in debt with cheaper game production no?

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: No doubt about that. Ironically, this would have been impossible, since Far-Left people like the ones from this studio are the most rabid Anti-AI "activists".
